Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our call and suggested next steps to keep momentum:

- Acme is prioritizing API latency for user-facing features and predictable cost for high volume embedding workloads.
- Main blockers: VP/CTO alignment on data residency and security posture, and a short technical deep-dive to validate integration effort.
- Target timeline: PoC kickoff in June if execs sign off.

Proposed next steps
1) Executive alignment (VP/CTO intro) — short 30-min intro to unblock procurement and security questions. We can cover our VPC/on-prem options, SOC 2 scope, and typical enterprise rollouts.
2) Technical deep-dive / demo — 45–60 min with Neha (solutions engineer) to walk architecture, quantization/latency tradeoffs, and integration checklist.

Suggested windows (PT):
- Tue 25 May, 09:00–10:00 or 11:00–12:00
- Wed 26 May, 13:00–14:00 or 15:00–16:00
(If none work, please propose two slots that suit Ben and the platform team.)

I’ve attached a short capabilities deck and the call notes. If you’d like, happy to loop in Rishi (our VP of Sales) for the executive intro — he can speak to procurement/contract timelines.

Next actions
- Reply with preferred window for the exec intro and whether you want it before the technical demo.
- If you can loop Ben (CTO) on availability that would be great.

Thanks — looking forward to progressing this.
